newsitem.title: USA: U.S. December S&P 500s end lower ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. December S&P 500s end lower ahead of holiday.

text.p: Nov 27 - U.S. December S&P 500 futures ended lower ahead of the U.S. Thanksgiving day holiday on Thursday. Trade will be closed all day. Trade on all CME stock index futures will close at 1215 CST/1815 GMT on Friday. Dec fell in orderly trade. Dealers continued to roll positions into March.
